waypoints.name: Frenchman Coulee climbers' parking
waypoints.note: WDFW gravel lot off Vantage Road SW, the main lot for Echo Basin and the Sunshine Wall. Park with a Discover Pass or a WDFW Vehicle Access Pass. Since May 2026 the county has kept Vantage Road SW closed at Silica Road, so the lot cannot be reached by the road.

road.name: Vantage Road SW
road.status: Closed at Silica Road SW by Grant County after the May 15, 2026 rockslide, to drivers and to people on foot, with no reopening date (county update dated Sep 30, 2026).
road.driveNote: Leave I-90 at exit 143 and go north on Silica Road SW for about 0.8 mi. Turn left onto Vantage Road SW and drop into the coulee; past the Feathers, the main WDFW climbers' lot is on the left, about 1.4 mi along.
